The full `strongswan-5.8.2-statusall.txt` fixture is synthetic, shaped from the upstream strongSwan 5.8.2 stroke formatter and the deployment-reported header and selector examples. No production output or partner identities were copied. The full fixture reconciles 51 established and 11 connecting IKE SAs. Incomplete variants are generated by tests.
Source: https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/blob/5.8.2/src/libcharon/plugins/stroke/stroke_list.c

`strongswan-5.8.2-isolated-missing.txt` is an excerpt captured from source-built 5.8.2 in a network-disabled local container. Only loopback addresses and test identities were used; SPI values are sanitized. Both loopback IKE associations authenticated; the container could not install the outbound kernel IPsec SA and retained IKE without CHILD state. This is live parser/missing-state evidence, not a successful recovery or packet-flow test. See `docs/validation-v0.4.0.md`.
